name: Webshare
description: Enabling effortless content sharing on popular social media platforms. It provides users with customizable share buttons for networks like Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and more, helping you amplify your content reach easily.
project_description: Webshare adds social-sharing buttons to a Drupal site: a configurable "Share" rail for networks such as LinkedIn, Facebook, X, WhatsApp and a copy-to-clipboard action, plus an optional native Web Share API button that opens the device share sheet on supported browsers. Platforms are stored in a dedicated `webshare_platforms` database table (managed through an admin form or, declaratively, through config-action plugins in recipes) rather than in config, and administrators can add fully custom platforms by supplying a URL template ([url] / [title] placeholders) and an uploaded icon. Rendering is delegated to a single-directory component (webshare:share) and a Block plugin, so the share rail can be placed via Block layout, exposed as a Views field on nodes / commerce products, or dropped onto content templates in Drupal Canvas. Presentation options (heading, start/end alignment, horizontal/vertical orientation, mobile visibility, inline vs. sticky rail placement) live on the block/component. Icons are library-agnostic: the module renders bundled SVGs by default but can map any platform to the Drupal Core Icons API (or the ui_icons contrib pack) via configuration.
